_comment: Shared table pinning the kappa-sigma lone-outlier depth bound in both languages: seestack.stack.stacker.kappa_min_frames and frontend/src/kappaMinFrames.ts::kappaMinFrames must agree on every row. Driven from tests/test_kappa_min_frames_mirror.py and from frontend/src/kappaMinFrames.test.ts - change the rule and you have to change this table. Only kappa > 0 is listed: a non-positive or unreadable kappa is a frontend-only guard (it answers null) and is not a case the engine's function is ever asked.
